name: Hollow Non-Answers
effect: The altered model mostly fails to engage with the prompt. It gives empty '<think>' tags, stock evasions ('I don't have a specific answer', 'How can I respond?'), vague grandiose filler, or a 'meaning of life' phrase that repeats in a loop.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
